name: Windsurf
description: Windsurf is an AI coding environment now associated with Cognition; Cognition's platform terms list a San Francisco, California address. It is focused on agentic software development, code editing, and developer productivity.

sources.notes: Cognition's official platform terms identify Cognition AI, Inc. and list 550 Third Street, San Francisco, California 94107 for notices; the terms also identify Windsurf as the former Exafunction product.
